notes.title: 1.0.4 Bugfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Date lables blocked clicking on the date to change it. It's fixed now.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Bugfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- The player now exits the car from the side that is highest up. This will make it less likely to clip through the ground when exiting. Horse also has this feature.
- Revolver resets to the banker when you start the western mission
- Western delivery trigger is not attached to the film camera now.
- GPS markers added for "Bank Run!"
- John's trigger for the express delivery is slightly bigger now.
- Typo in "Bank Run!" tagline is now fixed

notes.title: 1.0.2 Bugfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
The first proper bugfix is now available!

Mission Changes
Bank Job
 - Now requires only 4 Moneybags and will spawn 6. So you can loose 2.
 - Thiefs are slightly slower
Fishing for Cardboard
 - Increased time from 90 to 120 seconds
Apartia Pipeline
 - Increased time from 75 to 90 seconds
Holiday Rush!
 - Decreased time from 300 to 270 seconds

Bug Fixes
- Money counter should be less buggy and more accurate now
- Helekopeter logo background now fills the screen properly
- Pot Head and Top Hat are now visible in-game
- Day, month, year labels added to not confuse americans
- Spawnable Brick is now locked by default.
- Picking up packages directly from the dove now properly detaches the package.
- Rocks in the cave light fixed
- A lot of sound effects ignored the volume slider. This should be fixed now.
- Horse Quality now updates instantly even if you reset the horse by starting "Movie Set Delivery"
